notes:
- Company: OnboardMate Systems (mid-market product analytics SaaS). Building in-app onboarding copilots (guided flows) to surface step-by-step product setup and help agents.
- Primary goal: low, consistent latency for chat/agent interactions (streaming) and reliable tool-calling (open modal, trigger onboarding steps). Initial SLO target: first-token <150ms for hosted edge region, streaming increments perceived <=200-300ms.
- Cost sensitivity: strict token caps per onboarding session; want predictable per-user cost and suggestions for batching/caching to hit targets. May accept quantized model variants for cost if latency maintained.
- Current plan: start Hosted API POC (2 weeks) focusing on streaming + tool-calling integration in staging, run 10k session equivalent load to profile latency and tail. If meets latency & cost targets, move to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration, retention controls, and EU data residency for EU customers. Asking for SOC2 / ISO artifacts.
- Sales/Procurement: asked AE for dual-pricing: Hosted consumption estimate + Dedicated reserved monthly commit tiers. Procurement expects line-item for dedicated GPUs and support SLA.
- Quotes from call: "Need consistent sub-200ms feel for onboarding steps — if users wait we lose activation." — PM Sarah L.
- Integrations: product sends events to Redwood for tool-calls (open modal, jump-to-step). Wants streaming with chunked tokens for progressive UI.
- Internal stakeholders: PM (Sarah L.), Eng Lead (Tom B.), Security (Eve R.), Head of Ops (Maya K.).
- Risks: procurement timeline 4-6 weeks, legal review for data residency; benchmarking needed to justify Dedicated spend.
- Requested deliverables: Hosted POC runbook, latency profile report, Hosted vs Dedicated pricing comparison, security pack (SOC2 + KMS integration notes).
